findings.net: Vencora UK Limited would probably win against VENQORI for online training in the UK, with similar exposure if its EU application registers.
findings.legal_position: The UK goods list includes unrestricted education, training and software development, so VENCORA is likely to win against the company's attached learning despite the final-vowel defence. The pending EU application creates corresponding prospective exposure, while its finance-only SaaS wording does not limit the separately listed general development and education services.
findings.practical_position: [Vencora's site](https://www.vencora.com/) confirms financial-software group activity, but the completed search did not confirm public VENCORA-branded courses or software-development sales. The UK right remains inside the verified [five-year non-use period](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/26/section/46), and no public enforcement record surfaced in [UKIPO decisions](https://www.ipo.gov.uk/t-challenge-decision-results.htm), so consent addresses Moderate's feasible-settlement position.

findings.net: Yongzhi would probably win against a 文科里 app name in China. Its case against VENQORI alone depends on an established Chinese pronunciation.
findings.legal_position: The registered goods include downloadable mobile applications (among broad goods), and 文克利 / WENKOLY wen ke li is likely to win against proposed 文科里 on their close spoken sequence. Different characters and tones provide reasonable defences, while VENQORI alone, without a corresponding Chinese pronunciation, gives the company the better argument.
findings.practical_position: The completed use and enforcement search found no attributable app, watch or water-software product and no public enforcement record. The registration's age permits a possible [three-year non-use challenge](https://www.cnipa.gov.cn/art/2019/6/25/art_104_67808.html), but genuine use remains unresolved and the registered right remains enforceable.

use_check.question: Assess current China marketplace use as of November 2026 of 文克利 / WENKOLY / wen ke li by Yongzhi Motor (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. 永治电机（深圳）有限公司 for downloadable mobile apps, water-quality software and smart watches. Cite sources and identify oppositions, disputes or court actions over this or similar marks. Verify official China non-use cancellation rule and period. Compare 文克利 and 文科里 pronunciation, meaning and potential brand confusion with Latin VENQORI. Do not infer market use from registrations.

findings.net: Vennory LLC would probably win a US environmental-app naming dispute if consumers already recognised its app-store name as identifying that business. That recognition must predate the company’s use.
findings.legal_position: If Vennory's app-store developer name has earlier protectable goodwill, its close sound and consumer environmental-data offering make it likely to win a US claim against VENQORI. [Weather Terminal](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/weather-terminal/id6758122087) reports weather and air quality, giving reasonable distinctions in function and developer-versus-product naming, while priority and any Spanish unregistered rights remain unresolved.
findings.practical_position: [Apple](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/minimal-blackjack/id6745051427?l=en-GB) identifies Vennory LLC as seller, resolving the missing attribution, and its US/Spain listings establish present app-store exposure. The completed research did not establish this owner's enforcement posture, so objection likelihood remains uncertain despite the shared consumer channel.

findings.net: AVENCORE would probably lose against VENQORI for water-monitoring software in France and the UK, although its broad app claims create a registration obstacle.
findings.legal_position: The French and UK goods lists cover downloadable applications and general software development, but AVENCORE's extra initial A and CORE ending distinguish the whole name sufficiently for the company probably to win. The US app wording is limited to industrial performance and cost optimisation, while its general development services remain adjacent, and Madrid designations alone do not establish protection everywhere.
findings.practical_position: [AVENCORE](https://avencore.com/en/expertise/industrial-data-science-ai/) offers bespoke industrial software work, while the completed search did not confirm a consumer-water app or UK software customers. The UK right is old enough for a possible [partial non-use challenge](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/26/section/46), France's qualifying registration date remains unverified, and the search found no public AVENCORE enforcement record in the [sources reviewed](https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/avencore-509989000).

findings.net: VENKARO LIMITED would probably lose against VENQORI for water-related online training in New Zealand, despite its unrestricted online-training claim.
findings.legal_position: The goods list includes providing online training and general software development alongside property-inspection SaaS, so the training overlap is real. VENKARO changes both later vowel sounds and their order against VENQORI, giving the company a good whole-name defence and the better prospect of winning.
findings.practical_position: The [privacy policy](https://venkoproperty.co.nz/privacy-policy) identifies VENKARO LIMITED as the operator of Venko Property, whose [services](https://venkoproperty.co.nz/) concern residential property management rather than a confirmed software product or course. The completed search found no public enforcement record, and the recent registration remains inside New Zealand's verified [three-year non-use period](https://www.legislation.govt.nz/act/public/2002/0049/latest/dlm164640.html).
